description: This file contains utility classes and methods for working with Azure Table storage, including constants, exception evaluation, error handling, and query construction, with conditional namespace definitions based on compilation symbols.

classes.name: AzureTableConstants
classes.description: Contains constants related to Azure Table storage, such as ETag, partition key, row key property names, and maximum batch size.

classes.name: AzureTableUtils
classes.description: Provides static utility methods for handling Azure Table storage operations, including exception evaluation, error classification, query generation, and logging helpers.

methods.name: TableStorageDataNotFound
methods.description: Determines if an exception indicates that the requested data does not exist in Azure Table storage.

methods.name: ExtractRestErrorCode
methods.description: Extracts REST error code from a RequestFailedException or nested exceptions.

methods.name: EvaluateException
methods.description: Evaluates an exception to extract HTTP status code and REST error code, indicating if the exception relates to a storage error.

methods.name: IsRetriableHttpError
methods.description: Checks if an HTTP status and REST error code correspond to a transient/retriable error condition.

methods.name: IsContentionError
methods.description: Determines if an HTTP status code indicates a storage contention error.

methods.name: IsNotFoundError
methods.description: Checks if an HTTP status code indicates a 'not found' error.

methods.name: ValidateTableName
methods.description: Validates a table name against Azure naming rules using a regex.

methods.name: SanitizeTableProperty
methods.description: Sanitizes a string to be a valid Azure PartitionKey or RowKey by replacing disallowed characters.

methods.name: AnalyzeReadException
methods.description: Analyzes an exception during a read operation to determine if it is retriable and logs details.

methods.name: PrintStorageException
methods.description: Formats a storage exception into a string with message, status, and error code.

methods.name: PointQuery
methods.description: Creates a query filter string for a point lookup by PartitionKey and RowKey.

methods.name: RangeQuery
methods.description: Creates a query filter string for a range of RowKeys within a PartitionKey.
